headline: Chicago O'Hare is running behind the other United hubs tonight.

items.text: Chicago O'Hare (ORD) is at 80% on time (within 30 minutes of schedule) so far today, with 460 departed, behind the other hubs, which are at 89% or better.
The other six United hubs reporting so far today are running normally, at 89% on time or better.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at a United hub. Seattle (SEA) has a ground delay program for flights into it until 9:59 PM PT, with delays averaging 32 minutes and up to 82 minutes.

Not in effect now: the FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark (EWR) tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET, and for flights into San Francisco (SFO) tomorrow after 7:00 AM PT.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, since a ground delay program is holding flights into it until 9:59 PM PT.
